name: ConnectWise RMM
summary: ConnectWise RMM publishes no prices and routes buyers to a pricing request or a sales call. The page lists a free trial. Agents installed on devices send health and performance data to a central dashboard, scripts run in PowerShell, bash and batch, and alerts are prioritized for a 24/7 monitoring view.

facts.text: Endpoint management covers Windows, macOS, Linux, network and cloud devices.
The page links to a Trust Center but names no certifications itself.
ConnectWise sells a separate product, ConnectWise Automate, whose page says ConnectWise RMM covers more third-party applications for patching.

plans.name: Quote
plans.notes: No prices published; the page offers Request pricing and Talk to Sales
